policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Holy Family had not played a match this season until the one at Caldwell, and they won it. Two goals scored and one conceded is the whole of their record, and it puts them level on points with four sides who have been playing since August.

Georgian Court's nineteen goals are more than Dominican, Holy Family and Post have scored between them, yet they have conceded fifteen: the conference's scoring is concentrated in one side, and its defending is not.
Max Bond has made 49 saves for Chestnut Hill and conceded fifteen, a save percentage of .766.
